component.name: PineconeMC
component.summary: Discover, manage, and play Minecraft instances

description.p: PineconeMC is a custom Minecraft launcher, forked from Prism Launcher, that adds Ely.by account support.
It manages multiple isolated Minecraft instances, each with their own mods, resource packs, worlds and settings, and can install mods and modpacks directly from the launcher.
